name: streak-tracker
title: Streak tracker
description: A week of days with the streak count: filled for days done, ringed for today, hollow for what was missed.
docs: days lists the completed days as YYYY-MM-DD, and today is the day it is now: leave it out to read the browser's clock in timeZone once the page is live (until then the card holds its place with empty circles, so pass today when you render on the server). The count is the run of days in a row that ends today, or yesterday while today is still open, so it only falls to nothing after a whole day was missed. The week starts on weekStartsOn, or on the locale's own first weekday, and a page left open past midnight moves on to the new day by itself. Every day has a name that says its state in words, such as Tuesday, done, so nothing depends on colour, and missed days are plain empty circles, never red. With onDayClick the days that have come are buttons and receive { date, done, today }. The count is a status: it is read out when it changes and swells quietly when today is completed, unless motion is reduced. labels carries every word.
